finding.summary: The new blank-cell skip in `Arguments.iterate` is applied to every range, not just unbounded ones, silently changing results of existing bounded-range formulas for all consumers of the shared iterator.
finding.evidence: arguments.ts:116-123 skips any blank cell whenever `isSrng(node.v)`. Unconsidered consumers: functions-logical.ts:111 (`AND`), :133 (`OR`), :174 (`XOR`) — a blank in `=AND(A1:A3)` used to yield `false` via ref2bool (arguments.ts:194) and short-circuit FALSE; it is now skipped, so the result flips to TRUE. functions-math.ts:247 (`PRODUCT`) used to return 0 for a range containing a blank, now returns the product of non-blanks; also :874 (`GCD`), :898 (`LCM`), :1392 (`SUMSQ`). functions-statistical.ts:31 (`AVERAGE` divisor), :56 (`MEDIAN`), :645/:670 (`STDEV`), :695/:720 (`VAR`), :745 (`MODE`), :1242/:1261/:1280/:1299 all change their value sets. Only MIN/MAX have tests for the new semantics (test/formula/formula.test.ts:4412-4437); the boolean and product consumers have none.
